notes.title: Small Modding Fix
notes.notes:
We've been keeping an eye on things that break as folks mod them, and the latest fixes are in this latest build! Let us know if anything else goes wrong in the meantime.

--Xalavier

notes.title: Omega Update Fixes and Expansion
notes.notes:
Heya, folks!

This is an update to fix a couple issues y'all found with the Omega Update--and to expand modding accessibility even further!

Basically, we've dumped the [b]entire game[/b], in the form of a mod, in the install folder of the game, along with a readme. It should be a great starting place for your own creations, and we can't wait to see them. 

Good luck with your organ building!

--Xalavier

notes.title: OMEGA UPDATE - Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/b62e5a2be8d1e82dbd7cf28246e817628285ffb5.png[/img]

NEW ENDINGS
NEW QUESTS
STEAM WORKSHOP SUPPORT
INSCRYPTION, BUGSNAX, AND SURPRISE UNPACKING-INSPIRED CONTENT
THIS IS THE OMEGA UPDATE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/9bda46f9e9a38326528bb356ebd82f949dc8f19f.png[/img]
New ending!
First off, in this new, Inscryption-inspired storyline, we've heard you, and added a way to get rid of those pesky scammers.
There will be consequences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/ec80aeabbb06ac565a85b3ff6ade62136bde0d1c.png[/img]
New quests!
Featuring the existential horrors of Inscryption, the strange creatures of Bugsnax,and... the cardboard boxes of Unpacking?! How did that get in here??

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/7278f4380b0249e5e3091706e89f541d2d866d27.png[/img]
New events!
Get your MarketScope, free gifts from rogue AIs, and react to even more varied and surprising moments in intergalactic news! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/f2bd355b843c5835f7b674d87ea3ca500386c42a.png[/img]
Steam Workshop modding!
We've massively expanded the modding capability of the game, allowing for new storylines, new traders--even your own endings! You can also change the modifiers of your experience to create your own ideal challenge scenarios.

We continue to appreciate your support of our meaty little game, whether you've been here for a day or the past couple years--and with your own passion, we're excited to see Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator take on a life of its own.

May your organs be valuable and your profits plenty,
--Kawa, Space Warlord Producer

notes.title: Morrowind GOTY Edition leads Amazon Prime’s free game offerings for February
notes.notes:
February might be the shortest month, but this year it’s jam-packed with free games for anyone with an Amazon Prime membership. There’s nine games up for keepsies over the course of the month, with The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind GOTY Edition standing out at the front of the pack from February 2nd. Members will also get to claim the bathhouse management game Onsen Master, futuristic 3D runner Aerial_Knight's Never Yield, and chibi god-brawler Divine Knockout in the first half of the month.

Read more

notes.title: The Steam Awards Nominations Are Open and We Need YOU!
notes.notes:
When we set out to make Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator, we knew we wanted a retro-futuristic vibe. From the bespoke pixel art to the font choices and the sickly green of old school monitors, we wanted this game to bleed with style.

Along the way, we've included old favorites (who's a good boy, Chad Shakespeare?) and new friends (who doesn't love a good Bean Bone?). But through it all we've done it all for you. Now we're asking for a little bit of help.

All you need to do is nominate us using this fancy tool and help us on our way toward being included in this year's Steam Awards! Thank you for considering us for all of your organ and award season needs!

notes.title: BEAN BONE UPDATE - Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/b6143ccd2c2dc8342b4cc27add491a9a8931652e.png[/img]

NEW ORGAN.
NEW QUESTS.
NEW PORTRAITS.
LIVE IT UP, DELICIOUSLY.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/0510a024569d41aebce665da1c6f9dca97bf2d87.png[/img]

Our Among Us-themed crossover with Innersloth Games is live! Succulent Bean Bones are now available for trade, and you can bring them to a greater variety of requesters than ever before as they challenge your trading skills in new, varied ways.

Non-exhaustive patch notes:
- A new organ: the Bean Bone.
- Players can now help Interstellar Influencers go viral (and make their subsequent apologies) on the galactic stage.
- New selectable character portraits, to help you assume the perfect persona as your fame climbs.
- A multitude of new quests, for even more varied ways to supply meat to a ravenous universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/7f909c775a1ddc4354e6078f92bc73912dea85c4.png[/img]

Whether you've been an organ-trading FIEND from day 1 or just came aboard with the fancy new discount, we're delighted to have you along for the ride - and have more updates lined up in the future! Look forward to additional questlines and galaxy-changing events, as well as crossovers featuring Inscryption, Bugsnax, and a [i]secret guest.[/i]

Thanks for your support, and we look forward to delivering even more viscous goodness soon.

May your organs be valuable and your profits plenty,
--Xalavier

notes.title: CROSSOVERS + VINYL + PHYSICAL - Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=D8YAA-FJY7g;full][/previewyoutube]
I'll be fast, and brief, because it's one o'clock in the morning as I write this and I am JAZZED to talk about organs.

NEW QUESTLINES - ONE ABOUT DOG MECHAS, AND ANOTHER ABOUT BUILDING A RELIGION OF MEAT.
NEW EVENT ABOUT FRAMING CRYSTALLINE POLITICIANS.
REVISED BALANCING SLIGHTLY DEFYING THE RIGID HORROR FOUND UNDER LATE-STAGE CAPITALISM.
AND A GIANT SET OF ANNOUNCEMENTS ABOUT THE FUTURE OF SPACE WARLORD ORGAN TRADING SIMULATOR.

Not only is the update above [i]already in your copy of the game[/i], but we are also newly available on the Nintendo Switch (as well as Steam Deck Verified), the game is getting a physical edition, the soundtrack is coming to vinyl, AND you can expect content updates based on the universes of [b]Inscryption[/b], [b]Among Us[/b], and [b]Bugsnax[/b] in the near future.

The link to the new physical hotness can be found below:
[url=https://store.serenityforge.com/]https://store.serenityforge.com/[/url]

Just in time for LudoNarraCon and this awesome cavalcade of news, there's a handy discount to celebrate. Maybe pick up the game for a friend! Or, someone you'd like to actively distress with the existential reality of our economic systems. I won't judge either way.

Thanks for the support, y'all.

May your organs be valuable and your profits plenty,
[i]--Xalavier, Lead Developer[/i]

notes.title: (Quiet Ending Update, Shhhhh)
notes.notes:
So, we did add two [b]full new[/b] storylines to the game... but, I'm not totally certain that they work, for sure. Also, people pay you more for tattooing an advertisement hologram on your skin.

We've got very, very big things coming along that have been percolating for a while, and I dearly appreciate your patience as this among other improvements to the game have been coming together. Let me know if anything goes horribly, terrifyingly wrong--and thanks for your support.

--Xalavier

notes.title: HARVESTER UPDATE - Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/2ab61d3a00b87ac4c81b22cb0a95af07cf4ea5f6.png[/img]

MOD SUPPORT.
NEW QUESTS.
NEW EVENTS.
A MARKET OF FEES AND FOES WILLING TO KICK YOU IN THE TEETH.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/ebbd6ef3854064d4eb130140333eab2bf748ca21.png[/img]

The Harvester update is our big re-introduction to the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator, and a thank you to the community who's been supporting the game. You can expect an even more expansive early game, consequences that keep you on your toes, a discount to celebrate the occasion--and more updates to come.

Non-exhaustive patch notes:
- Player can replace existing character portraits, and add new player portraits of their own.
- Player can modify game text and translations.
- Player can add new organs to buy, sell, and list on the intergalactic organ stock market.
- Player can now sell organs to children.
- Player can now interact with a mysterious AI, 'Hol.low'.
- Player can now trade with molten flesh horrors failed by the organ market.
- Player can now work alongside the harvesters that quietly keep the organ market running.
- Player can now be struck by fees for air, living quarters, security, and lawsuit settlements.
- Currency overflow bug fixed.
- Warlord Orbis will take the money he is owed.
- Player cannot own more than 2 billion credits, as God and the universe intended.
- Dog Soul disaster image changed for consistency and menacing effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/78eebcc5f5d74712bfc8e06552cd6855589ec2c1.png[/img]

All of the mod tools and templates are inside of the game folder.

Next on the docket is new plotlines and endings... I'm thinking we'll start with a dog mecha. Thanks for the support as always--and look forward to a bright, meat-filled future.

May your organs be valuable and your profits plenty,
[i]--Xalavier, Lead Developer[/i]

notes.title: (Quiet Modding Update, Shhhhh)
notes.notes:
If you look in the project folder, you'll now find tools, examples, and instructions for modding Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

Here's what you can do:
- Change existing character portraits and add new player portraits of your own
- Modify game text and translations
- Add new organs to buy, sell, and list on the intergalactic organ stock market

We're going to be making a [b]much[/b] bigger deal about this soon, but we also wanted to get this in your hands as soon as it was ready rather than delay for a splashy announcement--if only to make sure that it all worked. Thanks for your continued support and passion for our meat-filled universe.

--Xalavier

notes.title: Hotfix #6
notes.notes:
- Getting a Dog Soul no longer breaks your game
- The market suffers for longer, and more fervently

notes.title: First Big Content Update!
notes.notes:
A bunch of groundwork has occurred behind the scenes for new content - and this update features a ton of new events that can alter your trading adventure! Investigate missing organ scientists at your peril.

Next up, you can look forward toa large batch of new quests and questgivers. I will also look into ways to make the universe more cruel, for I now know what feats you are capable of.

Be afraid.

notes.notes: What it says on the tin - also, some updated Russian translation strings are coming soon.

notes.notes:
- Mr. Bucket now accepts a Large Firosta, as God intended

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
- We finally fixed that resolution bug, I think!
- You can change your cool cyber background, or remove it entirely to avoid motion sickness!
- We added more hotkeys to empower your purchases, for M+K and controller-using players!
- We tell you that there are more storylines/endings to find, in case you didn't know! It's kind of important!

- More!!!

notes.notes:
- We fixed Kinect support, and also made it better!
- We added more sound feedback!
- We fixed the bug with the credits overlapping two music tracks!
- You can quick-buy an organ you're inspecting, and there's a second buy button, which should help with mistaken clicks (although you will still absolutely get an item sniped out from under you by Chad Shakespeare)!
- M+K players now have a quick-buy hotkey!
- More assorted improvements!!

notes.title: Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator is out now
notes.notes:
If you gotta get into trading digital assets, let them be organs in Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator. It's a trading sim in which you can buy and sell organs, in space, including an in-game stock market. It's out now.

Read more

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes: We've patched the game so that Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese-language players no longer have crushed fonts and text!

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes: We've done our first hotfix! Featuring a dynamic game speed adjuster players can control while in-game, a mute option that actually works, and English appearing in non-English languages! Also, minor fixes. Moving on to other, meatier needs, like the font fixes.

notes.title: Trading Cards Incoming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590305/495c89c373743f5c77f01126d9abe45dacf7426f.jpg[/img]

That's right - we've already been approved for trading card access! The items are under review by Valve as we speak, so you should soon be able to trade Hearts, Lungs, Leechlymphs and more in a terrifying replication of the market of the game that uses real-world money.

May God have mercy on us all.

Meanwhile, work continues on a big batch of hotfixes - and we identified the cause of the font readability issue that some languages are encountering. Those fixes are under development right now and we hope to see the first ones land in time for the weekend.

Thanks for your patience, and support, as always. It means the world.

May your organs be valuable and your profits plenty,
[i]--Xalavier, Lead Developer[/i]

notes.title: Immediate Plans
notes.notes:
Hiya, folks!

I'm writing this at 5 AM just to thank you all so much for supporting the game. I've been up pretty much non-stop since the launch reviewing feedback, tracking any bugs y'all have found, and generally reacting to the enthusiasm and amount of input that's flooding in (alongside the usual supply of organs from the Organ Barge).

We're a small team, so we have both limited resources and time to react to everything as quickly as we'd like, but it's exciting to see how many other people [b]really[/b] understand the new kind of game we've built here and are reacting with horror and delight to its world. With all of that said, here's some of the features we're already working on to make Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator even better in the very near future:

- Working with our translation agency to address localization quality.
- Reviewing font readability.
- Ability to slow down (or even speed up!) the timescale of the game for accessibility and player preference.
- Ability to quick skip credits.
- Measures to reduce accidental organ purchases.
- New requests featuring unscrupulous traders, wannabe organ investors, and children buying organs with their parents' interstellar credit cards.
- New events letting loose an unexpected planet killer, and the ability to investigate a universe-wide conspiracy.
- Additional world consequences and tracking to make your trading journey even more granular and reactive.

So, yeah: more improvements [b]and[/b] content additions are coming soon, and I deeply appreciate y'alls patience as we try to make Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator the best action-based body horror economics game in the galaxy, one step at a time.

May your organs be valuable and your profits plenty,
[i]--Xalavier, Lead Developer[/i]

notes.title: Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator may be the final Kinect game
notes.notes:
Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator

, announced last week with an extraordinary trailer, does largely what it says on the tin. “The information is in the title,” says its Steam description, blatantly written by developer Xalavier Nelson Jr. “There are slickened, detached meat products derived from alien and human bodies, and you sure do buy and sell them”. That’s that, then. But in a surprising exclusive, I can also reveal to you that SWOTS currently supports the Xbox Kinect (2010) as a control peripheral, plausibly making it the final Kinect game.

(more…)
